format: Contract manifest; executable validators are frozen by source hash, not an external JSON Schema validator

decomposition.span_convention: Code derives zero-based exclusive offsets from unique exact quotes; absent/ambiguous/out-of-order/overlapping quotes are rejected
decomposition.coverage: All content words, quantities, units and conditions; no split token or inner AND predicate. A leading AND connector is allowed in a later part. A claim without English AND is represented by exactly one quote containing the complete claim.
decomposition.repair: At most 2 attempts; structural repair reports the related scope/coverage failures together. Syntax repair regenerates without replaying malformed JSON. Other errors include prior output, capped at 6000 characters.
decomposition.semantic_gate: 18 unique development claims; all structural checks AND human predicate/coverage/quantifier/entity-metric/time-condition review before full 39-case inference
decomposition.scope_rules: Copy capitalization exactly. Preserve population modifiers in entity or condition. Simple time/dataset restrictions bind to their own AND clause. Only explicit leading comma-delimited temporal/dataset prefixes are shared. Each clause has at most one time and one dataset restriction; conflicting or unrepresentable restrictions stop incomplete with unsupported_scope_structure before generation. Other semantic scope assignments require review. A source-derived clause-local rule requires the complete metric predicate for supported positive take-duration and contain/use/evaluate immediate count-plus-object forms. Validator and decoder use the same helper: neither a bare verb nor a quantity/object fragment satisfies that requirement. Named properties remain accepted. Structural failures enter bounded repair with the required source span. This finite grammar is not a complete semantic parser; other predicate meanings still require individual human review.

assessment.truth_semantics: Positive predicate before applying the quantifier
assessment.complete_coverage: Quoted nonempty population with unique members and one observation per declared member
assessment.numeric_records: numeric is null, a legacy single check object, or a nonempty list of at most 16 check objects. Every independent quantity requirement must have its own cited check. Missing or unknown requirements cannot support; any established false requirement refutes the conjunction. Model-declared unknown association remains unknown. Definitive observations missing required numeric records enter bounded repair instead of valid NEI. A proved false requirement may refute without checking the remaining conjuncts. Unknown associations remain unknown. Population counts alone do not force measurement arithmetic.

numeric.requirements: Code derives an occurrence-based numeric_requirements list per normalized part. Offsets are relative to part.quote. Each quote binds a number to its immediate English unit/count noun; repeated values on different objects remain separate. A multi-quantity value check must use exactly one requirement quote as left.quote. Duplicate checks are rejected; each source_quote must be cited in that observation. Compound or ambiguous associations are not established by arithmetic.
numeric.arithmetic: Source-grounded Decimal; value comparison for each independent requirement, or ordered before/after change
numeric.unknown_policy: No implicit unit conversion, unsupported comparisons or ambiguous association
numeric.binding: Named properties keep literal metric binding. Supported complete take/contain/use/evaluate predicates bind the same verb family to the observed quantity, permitting exactly. No relation is established merely by matching a number or unit.
numeric.explicit_denial: A grounded positive observed X followed by not claimed Y refutes an exact, unqualified claim. Other negation, thresholds, hypothetical context and implicit unit conversion remain unsupported.

result.aggregation: Per-quantifier part decisions, then AND across parts

decoding.adapter: Public TokenEnforcer core plus Transformers prefix_allowed_tokens_fn; default serving backend has no constraint kwargs
decoding.decomposition: Schema required keys/types/arrays; quote/scope enums from exact source spans. AND clauses use separate object alternatives binding each quote to its local time/dataset restrictions plus explicit shared prefixes. No-AND claims require one complete quote. Unsupported scope structures fail preflight rather than generating against an impossible schema.
decoding.assessment: Exact source sentence/adjacent-sentence enums and bounded windows for long sentences (384 chars), exact member spans (up to eight words/160 chars), source-derived decimal/unit/quote operand alternatives, bounded prose/arrays. Validator still checks citation, requirement coverage and arithmetic; schema does not establish semantic entailment.
decoding.trace: Every generation records decoder policy and schema SHA256; missing/mismatched trace fails gate
decoding.scope_limit: At most 80 whitespace-separated claim words for finite source enums
decoding.limitations: Schema validity does not prove atomicity, correct scope or entailment; truncated output still fails validation; human review required; supported scope grammar is English AND and simple temporal/dataset phrases; whole no-AND quote does not prove semantic atomicity

summarizer.generator: Object with exactly answer (nonempty string) and evidence_spans (list of nonempty strings, possibly empty). Invalid output skips Critic and requests repair.
summarizer.critic: Object with boolean is_supported, nonempty reason, and action empty for support or rewrite/request_more_context/lower_confidence otherwise. Optional suggested_query is a nonempty string of at most 4000 characters.
summarizer.repair: Uses existing MAX_INTERNAL_RETRY=3; exhaustion returns unsupported, low confidence. Valid JSON and valid role schema are recorded separately in opt-in traces.

deadline: Absolute monotonic case deadline forwarded through RecordingBackend to a per-decode-step Transformers stopping criterion. Late parsed or invalid JSON is rejected with deadline_exceeded; partial generation and call logs are retained. Preparation checks the same deadline. This is cooperative and cannot interrupt a hung CUDA kernel; the hard process watchdog remains.
